recognize_zh: Kleihauer-Betke 酸洗脫染色中，整片紅血球都只剩淡粉紅的「鬼影」空殼（成人 HbA 已被酸洗出），此視野沒有看到被伊紅深染、充滿血紅素的胎兒紅血球（HbF 細胞）。
features: Uniform field of pale pink ghost red cells with only membrane outlines retained
Cells appear empty after acid elution of adult hemoglobin (HbA)
No darkly eosin-stained, hemoglobin-filled acid-resistant (HbF-containing) red cells in this field
No nucleated cells or leukocytes identifiable; densely packed monolayer
describe_en: Kleihauer-Betke acid elution preparation of peripheral blood shows a field of pale ghost red cells in which adult hemoglobin has been eluted, leaving only faintly stained membrane outlines. No acid-resistant, darkly staining fetal hemoglobin–containing cells are identified in this field. Interpretation requires counting a large number of cells (typically 2,000) with appropriate positive and negative controls to calculate the percentage of fetal cells and estimate fetomaternal hemorrhage volume. This field is consistent with HbA-containing (adult) red cells lacking detectable F cells.

ddx.vs: A positive test shows scattered bright pink, hemoglobin-filled fetal cells among ghost cells, which are absent in this field.

ddx.dx: Hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin, pancellular
ddx.vs: Pancellular HPFH shows HbF evenly distributed so nearly all cells retain stain, whereas heterocellular elevations (e.g., thalassemia, sickle cell) show a mixed population.
Under-elution leaves many cells partially stained with intermediate intensity, whereas this field shows uniformly empty ghosts.
